==Strategy==
==='''Chapter 1'''===
Very simple stage compared to the last few. As long as you have [[Surfer Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Castaway Cat]] and all [[Anti-unstarred Alien Treasures]] from [[Into the Future]], this stage is trivial. Just send out Castaway and a good line of 1-2 meatshields, and you should be good.

==='''Chapter 2'''===
Another fairly straightforward stage. Quite similar to Chapter 1, but now with [[UltraBaaBaa]]s, so along with some meatshields, [[:Category:Anti-Alien Cats|anti-Aliens]] and some attackers. Include a [[:Category:Barrier Breaker Cats|Barrier Breaker]] in your lineup, such as [[Fencer Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Kendo Cat]], [[Skirt Cat (Special Cat)|Loincloth Cat]], etc.

==='''Chapter 3'''===
Similar to Chapter 2, notable differences being increased amount of Star Pengs and one more Ursamajor. Again, you need to bring a Barrier Breaker for the UltraBaaBaas. A general anti-Alien build still works here, with [[Surfer Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Seafarer]], [[Rover Cat (Rare Cat)|Rover Cat Mk II]], possibly [[Psychocat (Rare Cat)|Neo Psychocat]].
